artifact.canonical_name: Gemini API January 2026 tool and lifecycle updates

claims.text: The Gemini API changelog records Computer Use tool support for gemini-3-pro-preview and gemini-3-flash-preview on January 29.
The changelog records a model lifecycle feature on January 12 and support for Cloud Storage/public/private pre-signed database URLs as input sources, with a 100 MB file limit, on January 8.
The changelog also records Veo 4K/portrait-output changes and several alias/deprecation events during January.

limitations: Computer Use support is tied to preview model identifiers and must preserve announcement-time preview/deprecation status.
The changelog establishes API availability, not independent quality or safety of computer-use behavior.
overrides.why_this_special: Concrete API-level evidence that frontier models were being connected to action tools and larger external data inputs, while lifecycle management became explicit.
overrides.rationale: Primary-source evidence supports Candidate Selection for a material January 2026 technical change.

claims.text: Mistral released Vibe 2.0 on January 27 as a terminal-native coding agent powered by the Devstral 2 model family.
The release added custom subagents, multi-choice clarifications, slash-command skills, unified agent modes, and automatic updates, with availability on Le Chat Pro/Team plus PAYG or BYOK paths.

limitations: The announcement is vendor-authored; claims about productivity or model quality are not independently reproduced.
Devstral 2 itself predates January, so the month-level event is the Vibe 2.0 agent/harness update rather than a new underlying model family.
overrides.why_this_special: A direct peer to Codex-style terminal agents, showing agent orchestration moving into configurable subagents, skills, and clarification/control mechanisms.
overrides.rationale: Primary-source evidence supports Candidate Selection for a material January 2026 technical change.
